# Loksevak AI

> Loksevak AI is a private, student-only learning app for the MPSC Group C Services Combined Preliminary Examination 2026 (Maharashtra, India), in Marathi with English available. It is not a coaching class's app and sells no courses. Every study tool is free: diagnostic test, daily study plan, practice scored by the MPSC rule, the cause of each mistake, spaced-repetition flashcards, an AI mentor with sources, notes, atlas and current affairs. The only paid items are the statewide live test every Sunday (INR 99 per test or INR 499 for the series of 10 tests to the exam) and the Super Pack (the series plus offline guidance sessions in Pune, Nashik and Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar with officers who cleared MPSC). After every live test comes a detailed analysis of the mistakes and a week of study planned around the weak topics. Loksevak AI is not connected with the Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) or the Government of Maharashtra; applications are made only at mpsconline.gov.in.

## Exam facts (source: MPSC corrigendum of 6 November 2026)

- Exam: MPSC Group C Services Combined Preliminary Examination 2026, advertisement 017/2026
- Posts: 16,717 across 27 cadres (largest: Clerk-Typist 3,966; Staff Nurse 3,911; Talathi 1,840; Craft Instructor 1,388; Assistant Agriculture Officer 1,203; Civil Engineering Assistant 934 + 949)
- Applications and options: 13 November 2026 to 27 November 2026 at mpsconline.gov.in; fee by 30 November 2026, online only
- Prelims: Sunday 24 January 2027, offline OMR, 100 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes, one quarter mark deducted per wrong answer, screening only
- Upper age limit relaxed by one year this year; Mains dates announced later by cadre
- Estimated competition: 15 lakh+ candidates (an estimate, not an official figure)
- Every figure above was checked row by row against the corrigendum PDF on 11 November 2026; the Commission's official publication has the final word

- Live Test 10: Sunday 17 January 2027, 11:00 AM IST

## Pricing

- Account and every study tool: free, no card
- One live test: INR 99
- Live test series (10 Sundays to the exam): INR 499
- Super Pack: ₹4,999 per year, includes the series and the offline sessions; seats limited
- Refunds: none; every payment is final (a missed test is not refunded; a duplicate charge for the same purchase is reversed as a payment error)
